# The Pew Charitable Trusts

> The Pew Charitable Trusts is a nonpartisan research organization advancing evidence-based solutions across health, economic opportunity, community development, conservation, and government policy.

Founded by the Pew family, the organization conducts rigorous policy research and partnerships to address critical challenges in public health, environmental conservation, economic advancement, and state/federal governance. Pew combines data-driven analysis with collaborative approaches to create measurable impact on pressing societal issues.

## Key Topics

- Public Policy Research
- Community Development
- Environmental Conservation
- Health & Well-being
- Economic Advancement
- Broadband Infrastructure
- Housing Affordability
- State Government Reform
- Marine Life Protection
- Nonprofit Research
- Policy Innovation
- Federal Policy
- Data-Driven Analysis
- Medical Innovation
- Suicide Prevention

## Core Research Topics

- [Advance Health & Well-Being](https://www.pew.org/en/topics/advance-health-and-well-being): Pew's health and well-being research initiatives including mental health and substance use
- [Build Communities](https://www.pew.org/en/topics/build-communities): Community development focus: broadband, energy infrastructure, mental health, legal solutions
- [Improve Economic Advancement](https://www.pew.org/en/topics/improve-economic-advancement): Economic opportunity initiatives covering student loans, housing, retirement savings, and jobs
- [Improve Federal Policy](https://www.pew.org/en/topics/improve-federal-policy): Nonpartisan federal policy research on housing, broadband, energy, and healthcare
- [Strengthen State Government](https://www.pew.org/en/topics/strengthen-state-government): State and local government policy solutions for budgets, broadband, housing, and disaster aid
- [Protect Marine Life](https://www.pew.org/en/topics/protect-marine-life): Marine conservation work addressing overfishing, habitat loss, and fisheries management
- [Support People & Nature](https://www.pew.org/en/topics/support-people-and-nature): Conservation and land/water protection partnerships benefiting wildlife and communities

## About & Organization

- [Mission & Values](https://www.pew.org/en/about/mission-and-values): Pew's mission, organizational values, and founding history by the Pew family
- [How We Work](https://www.pew.org/en/about/how-we-work): Pew's research methodology, partnerships, and evidence-based approach to impact
- [Philanthropic Partnerships](https://www.pew.org/en/about/philanthropic-partnerships): Pew's collaborations with foundations and organizations on conservation and policy

## Research & Insights

- [Insights & Perspectives](https://www.pew.org/en/insights-and-perspectives): Nonpartisan research reports, essays, and analysis from Pew experts and publications
- [Suicide Risk Reduction Project](https://www.pew.org/en/projects/suicide-risk-reduction-project): Pew's suicide prevention initiative with evidence-based screening and health interventions
- [Trend Magazine - Fall 2025](https://www.pew.org/en/trend): Trend Magazine Fall 2025 issue featuring medical innovation and AI health technology
- [Trust Magazine - Winter 2026](https://www.pew.org/en/trust): Trust Magazine Winter 2026 issue on conservation and indigenous communities

## Media & Resources

- [News Room](https://www.pew.org/en/about/news-room): Media resources, press releases, and expert contacts for journalists and researchers
